title: Autonomous Maintenance Platform — Containers (C2) · MVP as built, 2026-07

nodes.name: Control Plane / Scheduler
nodes.desc: Tick: observe GitHub → advance the task state machine → run one burst (serial). Rails: attempts, review rounds, daily ceiling, hard budget cap; kill switch; crash recovery

nodes.name: Dev Burst
nodes.desc: Resumes the per-task session; clone rw; branch → code → test → open PR; replies in review threads (fix/reply/defer)

nodes.name: Reviewer Burst (assess)
nodes.desc: Fresh session; clone read-only at PR head; NO GitHub credential — findings return via harvest

nodes.name: Test Burst (tester)
nodes.desc: Fresh session; NO GitHub credential; boots the product from the PR head, invents scenarios from TESTING.md + specs, runs them E2E

nodes.name: Ledger
nodes.desc: tasks · bursts · violations: status, attempts, rounds, review cursor, session ids

nodes.name: Session Archive
nodes.desc: Task-keyed resumable transcripts; burst volumes kept for forensics. (Postgres + SeaweedFS = the designed scale-up, not built)

nodes.name: Product
nodes.desc: Maintained product; own repo, own CI

nodes.name: GitHub
nodes.desc: Integration substrate / source of truth for task + delivery state

nodes.name: Claude (Anthropic)
nodes.desc: Engine for all three burst roles

nodes.name: GitHub Copilot
nodes.desc: Requested per PR on the owner's PAT (echo-verified — App tokens are silently dropped)

nodes.name: Product Sandbox
nodes.desc: Disposable by construction; creds provisioned platform-side under TEST_*, injected into tester bursts only

nodes.name: Monitor
nodes.desc: Will file auto issues from prod telemetry; the tester's symptom relay already exercises that pipeline

edges.label: Polls issues/PRs/reviews; labels; posts reviews + test reports as the reviewer App; relays tester auto issues; requests Copilot (owner PAT)
Spawns work/review bursts: task prompt + dev App token + seeded session volume [Docker]
Spawns on PR open + after every push
Spawns after a clean assess (APPROVE); injects TESTING.md ∩ TEST_* env
Seed volume before boot; harvest result + session after
Clone, push dev/<n>-*, open PR, reply in threads [dev App token]
Boots the product, drives scenarios E2E
